description: This file contains source code for an Android application that renders 3D OBJ models using OpenGL ES. It defines the main activity 'OBJViewer' and a custom view 'OBJView' responsible for rendering, user interaction, and managing 3D objects. The code manages loading various 3D model files, rendering them with transformations, and handling user input for rotating and switching models.

classes.name: OBJView
classes.description: Custom view handling 3D rendering, user interaction, and animation for displaying OBJ models.

classes.name: OBJViewer
classes.description: Main Android activity that initializes the application, manages the 3D objects, and sets up the rendering view.

methods.name: OBJView.reset
methods.description: Resets the view state and rotation parameters to initial conditions.

methods.name: OBJView.onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events for rotating, tilting, and switching objects.

methods.name: OBJView.init
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL settings for rendering the 3D scene.

methods.name: OBJViewer.getObject
methods.description: Returns the current 3D object being displayed.

methods.name: OBJViewer.nextObject
methods.description: Loads the next 3D model in the list.
